title: Final Clebsch-Gordan Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly compute the Clebsch-Gordan coefficient for J=3/2, M=1/2.

title: Final Cross Section Ratios
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct ratio of cross sections for both resonance cases.

title: Use of Angular Momentum Operators
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of how to apply angular momentum operators in the context of Clebsch-Gordan coefficients.

title: Isospin Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the conservation of isospin in the context of the given reactions.

title: Neglecting Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the neglect of terms in the cross section calculations at resonance energies.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations of coefficients and cross sections.
